content:
Every final result can be written as a signed sum
\[
\sum_{i=0}^{16} \varepsilon_i 2^i,\qquad \varepsilon_i\in\{+1,-1\}.
\]
Since the last operation is a subtraction, the signs cannot all be positive, so at least one coefficient is \(-1\). To maximize the sum, make the smallest term, \(1\), negative. Thus
\[
\text{final}\le (1+2+4+\cdots+65536)-2\cdot 1
=(2^{17}-1)-2=131069.
\]
This is achievable:
\[
2-(1-4-8-\cdots-65536)
=2-1+4+8+\cdots+65536=131069.
\]
Therefore the largest possible remaining number is
\[
\boxed{131069}.
\]
